item.title: Kissy Kissy ~Watashi no Tamago~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mini
  • 発売日: 2007-02-23
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Kissy Kissy ～わたしのたまご～
  • 英語名: Kissy Kissy Watashi no Tamago

あらすじ

The story centers around Junichi, a student and convenience store clerk. Upon his way back from work, his peaceful life takes a sudden stop as he finds an unconscious girl on the beach. Being the nice guy that he is, Junichi rescues her and brings her to his house. After waking up, the girl draws a blank in her memory. Who she is, where she came from, things that we usually take for granted was lost to her. Still, even with all that she has lost, she has one strong desire. That desire was to stay here, with Junichi.

item.title: Shimai Kyoushidon
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mini
  • 発売日: 2005-07-29
  • スコア: 6.4/10 (10 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 姉妹教師丼
  • 英語名: Shimai Kyoushidon

あらすじ

Two new female teachers arrive to a Tokyo private boys school. Main character accidentally gets attached not to just one, but to both these newbie teachers to help them adapt in an unfamiliar environment. Chief director demands to solve this situation within two weeks so that only one teacher gets attached. The women agree that it’s up for protagonist to decide after two weeks. The competition gradually escalates…
